# FacePass v0.1.5

## English

FacePass v0.1.5 improves the sensitive local recognition gate used for approved lock-screen assist and approved administrator/System Settings prompt fill. When the camera sees a usable face that is below the similarity threshold or has not matched yet, FacePass now keeps trying within the existing 10-second recognition window instead of ending the attempt early.

Recognition still returns immediately once the required accepted matches are collected, so a successful attempt does not wait out the full 10 seconds. Hard failures still stop immediately.

The security boundary is unchanged. FacePass is not Apple Face ID, Touch ID, or a replacement for macOS authentication. Ordinary webpage and app password fields remain unsupported. Administrator/System Settings prompt fill remains value-only: FacePass does not click, submit, or press Return for those prompts. FacePass does not upload passwords, face data, raw camera frames, unlock state, or environment signals, and this release adds no telemetry or cloud behavior.

## 中文

FacePass v0.1.5 改进了用于已批准锁屏辅助和已批准管理员/System Settings 提示填充的敏感本地识别 gate。当摄像头看到可用人脸, 但相似度低于阈值或尚未匹配时, FacePass 现在会在现有 10 秒识别窗口内继续尝试, 不会过早结束本次识别。

收集到所需的通过匹配后, 识别仍会立即返回, 因此成功时用户不需要等完整 10 秒。硬失败仍会立即停止。

安全边界没有变化。FacePass 不是 Apple Face ID、Touch ID, 也不是 macOS 系统认证的替代品。普通网页和普通 app 密码输入框仍不受支持。管理员/System Settings 提示填充仍然只填入密码值: FacePass 不会为这些提示点击、提交或按 Return。FacePass 不会上传密码、人脸数据、原始摄像头帧、解锁状态或环境信号, 本版本也没有新增 telemetry 或 cloud 行为。
